purpose: Determine whether the sole failed number-specificity arm in the complete MLP6/MLP7 factorial is stable under a second same-number different-lemma donor family, and whether completing the donor state through MLP7 reproducibly cancels the MLP6-exposed lexical effect.

binding_parent.finding: Instrument and exact parent closure held. The only registered specificity failure was plural_to_singular/between_below, EAUWY full margin: lexical effect 0.02882576 over opposite-number full-source effect 0.11147976, ratio 0.25857393. EAUWYZ lexical effect was 0.01076782, so donor MLP7 suppressed 62.64% of the mixed-state lexical effect.

novelty_audit: The parent complete factorial used one fixed same-number lexical donor profile only.
Earlier Task14 controls establish that control-family choice can change causal verdicts; no receipt tests this MLP6/MLP7 mixed corner with an independent same-number donor profile.
This is a targeted stability test of three frozen corners, not a repeated full factorial, rank analysis, activation reconstruction, or threshold search.

alternate_donor_rule.construction: Replace only the final one-token subject in the existing same-number donor endpoint according to this prospective cycle; retain each row's context, recipient, opposite-number source, answers, split, and intervention position.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: Native role replay, raw/full-source MLP8 endpoint, propagated slot, installed head, and recipient no-op errors are each at most 5e-5; every alternate lexical donor has positive native answer margin.
predictions.pred_b_lexical_entanglement_replicates: The primary-cell EAUWY full-margin collateral divided by the frozen parent opposite-number EAUWYZ full-margin effect is at least 0.25.
predictions.pred_c_control_family_sensitive: The same ratio is below 0.25. This is mutually exclusive with prediction b and means the fine split is not stable across plausible lexical controls.
predictions.pred_d_mlp7_completion_cancels: Prediction b holds and abs(EAUWYZ lexical full-margin effect) is at most 0.60 times abs(EAUWY), with the signed completion change opposing EAUWY.
predictions.pred_e_reciprocal_mixed_corner_quiet: The primary-cell EAUWZ full-margin ratio is below 0.25.

null: If the instrument holds but b and d fail, the original lexical failure does not replicate as an MLP6-exposed/MLP7-cancelled interaction. The MLP6/7 split remains unpromoted because its registered parent control already failed; no threshold is relaxed.
closed_claims: sufficiency outside the fixed L11H3 interface
